title: Me: search area spacing differs across tabs
evidence: Friends: tabs end y311; search frame y325–371 (14pt above); first player avatar begins about y398.5 (27.5pt below the field). Inbox search starts flush at y311 and is 44pt tall. Both inputs are centered within their own frames.
impact: Uneven surrounding rhythm makes the Friends field appear detached, while Inbox feels compressed beneath the tabs.
proposal: Use one approved Me control-area rhythm: consistent outer gutter, tab-to-control gap and control-to-content gap. Keep the compact text sizes; do not resize text to solve this.
verification: Compare Friends and Inbox at all three widths; measure visible gaps and field/icon centerlines.

title: Me Inbox: section headers, cards and notification rows lack one content rhythm
evidence: GAMES heading ends y386; the review card starts y390: 4pt. FRIEND REQUESTS ends y604; its first visible avatar starts about y618.5. Game/request groups use 20pt outer gutters, while the invite notification is a full-width row with its text starting x38 and its timestamp centered on the full row.
impact: Related inbox sections change density and edge treatment; notification time does not share the title baseline.
proposal: Define one section-title-to-content gap and one row shell. Attach notification time to a deliberate title or metadata baseline; retain the marker gutter and existing wording.
verification: Compare pending/all, review cards, friend requests and invites; measure section gaps and timestamp baselines.

title: Me hero: full court-name fallback is ellipsized
evidence: With the 10-character username abcdefghij and a 24-character legacy display name, the valid full court fallback Rancho Cienega Sports Complex is cut to Rancho Cienega Sports Co… at 375/393/430. The display name itself fits two lines.
impact: The user cannot read the full local-court identity in the hero.
proposal: Preserve the short-name preference; allow an appropriate second metadata line when only a long full name exists, keeping the ELO column stable.
verification: Repeat with a real short alias and a long full-name fallback; full identity visible and ELO position stable.

title: Me activity: long court context disappears in one-line rows
evidence: Played 45m at Rancho Cienega Sports Complex and Scheduled a game at Rancho Cienega Sports Complex are ellipsized. Confirmed at 375/393/430 using the same valid-length username fixture.
impact: The action is readable but its court context is incomplete.
proposal: Keep the score/time columns reserved; move long court context to a second line or the existing metadata row. Adjust the shared ActivityRow so other callers stay consistent.
verification: Check Me and peer Activity, short/long court names, with score/time columns and tab-floor clearance.

title: Settings: enlarged labels are not an accepted visual target
evidence: Current PR uses 14pt label/value text and 12pt descriptions, up from 11pt labels/descriptions. Jesse rejected the larger result on November 24. Current code fitting does not establish visual approval.
impact: The page feels heavier and gives long values less horizontal room than the requested compact treatment.
proposal: Review a compact typography correction against the earlier Settings screenshot while preserving the shared row owner, safe switch inset and intrinsic switch. No blanket 17pt rule. Agree the exact scale visually before implementation.
verification: Matched original/current/proposed screenshots at 375/393/430, identical data, with long court fallback.

title: LocalList drawer: Default controls are detached from the court
evidence: A small star plus Default label and a separate large star sit in their own row above the court card, unlike Explore’s attached default marker.
impact: The action/state appears to belong to an empty row rather than the court it controls.
proposal: Attach the default state/action to its court management row, including removal on a second saved court. Reuse the underlying LocalList actions.
verification: One/two courts, default/non-default, default/remove controls adjacent to the correct row; persistence remains a separate functional task.

title: LocalList drawer: repeated explanation and loose vertical composition
evidence: The title has an orange explanatory subtitle; another explanatory paragraph follows the large discovery-style card; the remaining drawer is mostly unused. The explanatory footer is not anchored to the bottom.
impact: Management controls compete with discovery-card styling, and the explanation appears duplicated.
proposal: Use compact court management rows, a single aligned search/header rhythm and one explanatory footer in the approved location. Any removal of wording requires review first.
verification: Compare one/two-court layouts, long names, empty search and small-phone scrolling without a floating control row.

classification: Observed web consistency defect; native unverified
title: Settings drawers: enabled switch thumb differs from main Settings
evidence: Main Settings push switch is white/orange in web. Friends’ check-ins in the auto-check-in drawer is teal/orange. Both configure native thumbColor; only the new SettingsRow maps RN Web’s separate enabled-thumb property.
impact: Identical on/off controls have visibly different styling.
proposal: Consolidate the existing native Switch presentation in one owner, preserving values, callbacks and disabled states. Validate iPhone intrinsic sizing separately.
verification: ON/OFF comparisons in main Settings, auto-check-in and score Hide controls; phone verification for actual native size.

title: Shared labels: several roles are below the documented 11pt minimum
evidence: Examples: Home/court stat captions 7.5pt; Me stats 9pt and tabs 9.5pt; court/player tab labels around 9pt; schedule weekday labels 9pt. Run and score metadata also contain sub-11pt roles. These are existing compact-design debts, not all introduced in PR #93.
impact: Important supporting labels become difficult to read despite fitting their boxes.
proposal: Review only the affected semantic roles with compact references: reduce redundant copy or rebalance layout where needed. Approve exact sizes per role; do not enlarge every label or use 17pt across the app.
verification: Read actual phone-scale screenshots; verify legibility, contrast, wrapping and row height after each separately approved role change.

title: Schedule cells and purchase links need touch-target review
evidence: Schedule heat cells measure about 39×20 at 375, 41×35 at 393 and 46×42 at 430. The grid cells have no hitSlop. LocalPlus links have 14pt-high visual boxes with hitSlop 10, yielding about 34pt vertical reach rather than 44. In contrast, the 32pt Going button already has hitSlop 6: do not flag it as a new defect.
impact: Dense controls can be difficult to select accurately.
proposal: Review the grid interaction at small width rather than squeezing text. Provide an adequately sized selection alternative or approved grid reflow. Give purchase links a true 44pt-high target without enlarging their text.
verification: Measure effective hit areas, test adjacent-cell selection on a phone and keyboard/screen-reader navigation. Browser rectangles alone cannot certify native hitSlop.

title: Home and expanded drawer: Here now roster leaves a large right-side gap
evidence: Four roster cells are fixed at 58pt with 8pt gaps: total 256pt inside a 353pt content lane at 393. They occupy x20–276, leaving 97pt before the right gutter. The unused space increases on wider phones.
impact: The row is left-weighted under a full-width heading despite the requested evenly distributed treatment.
proposal: Review equal-width roster columns or an explicitly aligned compact strip; preserve avatar size and apply the same owner to Home and expanded court drawer.
verification: Compare 0/1/2/4/5+ players at all widths, including the More control and longest visible first names.

title: Schedule opens on a time window that excludes its selected slot
evidence: Initial screenshot shows 4 AM–3 PM while the slot card says SAT 17 · 6 PM. Scrolling the heat area to its other window exposes the 6 PM selection.
impact: The selected detail and visible grid do not initially explain each other.
proposal: Make the initial heat window contain the selected/current time, preserving the existing morning/evening scrolling model.
verification: Cold-open before/after noon; selected slot visible or explicitly indicated, and manual window scrolling remains usable.

title: Explore: section headings and court cards use different outer gutters
evidence: LOCAL LIST and market headings begin x20; card frames begin x16 and end width−16. Home’s card/body lane uses x20. Hero internals and numeral centering currently look consistent.
impact: Stacked elements have a small but visible edge drift.
proposal: Review one body-gutter rule at the parent level. Preserve the approved compact hero geometry and fit behavior; do not add page-specific offsets.
verification: Measure heading/card/search edges on list and empty results at 375/393/430, then compare Home and the drawer.

title: Settings footer and authentication support note have weak contrast
evidence: LOCALCHECK 1.0.4 and the authentication note Your account stays signed in on this device measure about 2.4:1 against their backgrounds in the browser audit. They are supporting text, not disabled controls.
impact: The text is difficult to read even at its current size.
proposal: Use the existing readable secondary/muted token that meets the intended contrast. Correct color rather than increasing text size.
verification: Recheck actual foreground/background contrast and visually compare on phone brightness/dark mode.
